heading: Custom software, designed and delivered end to end

body.text: Cadocary is a software design and implementation consultancy. We take a client's product from first design through a shipped, working implementation — white-glove, end to end — so organizations get serious custom software that is better and cheaper at once.

body.alt: Frank B. Gilbreth quote from "Cheaper By The Dozen"

items: We own the whole build: design, engineering, and delivery of production software for organizations.
We ship measurable client outcomes, from a 20:1 ROI compliance engine to a cross-platform booking business.
We also package what we learn into productized tools like DocketBot and ClientCheck.
Better and cheaper at once: the same team designs and implements, so nothing gets lost in handoff.

body.text: We believe the best software takes an organization's hardest problem and turns it into a working system its people rely on every day — their most hated chore made into their favorite button.
Cadocary builds custom software for organizations — not just small desktop utilities. We design and implement complete systems and deliver them end to end, from first architecture through production.

items: Web platforms — customer-facing and internal applications built for scale.
Native mobile apps — production iOS and Android applications.
Data pipelines and web scraping — ingesting, cleaning, and structuring data at scale.
AI/ML integration — RAG-enabled chatbots and applied machine learning over real domain data.
Workflow automation — turning manual, repetitive processes into reliable software.

body.text: Every engagement is proof: we designed and implemented each one end to end, and our case studies show the outcomes clients report.
